lines.en: label library40part2:
scene futabayumisnow1
There’s no shade anywhere.
lines.zh: 哪里都没有阴凉。

lines.en: Or at least not on the way home, there isn’t.
lines.zh: 至少在回家的路上没有。

lines.en: I’m sure there’s shade in some part of the world because...the world is big and whatnot.
lines.zh: 世界上某个地方肯定有阴凉，因为……世界很大之类的。

lines.en: But, by comparison, my world is rather small.
lines.zh: 但相比之下，我的世界相当小。

lines.en: It’s small enough that, if I closed my eyes and didn’t mind wandering into traffic from time to time, I could probably learn to traverse it in complete darkness.
lines.zh: 小到如果我闭上眼睛、也不介意偶尔走进车流里，我大概能学会在全然的黑暗中穿行。

lines.en: Not that I’d want to do that or anything, but I do think it would be nicer at times.
lines.zh: 倒不是说我想那么做什么的，但我确实觉得那样有时候会更好。

lines.en: I’m sure Futaba would agree as well.
lines.zh: 我敢说 Futaba 也会同意。

lines.en: If everyone was blind and we all walked around with canes or seeing eye dogs, she’d never have to cope with the fact that her body isn’t what she wants it to be.
lines.zh: 如果所有人都是盲人，大家都拄着拐杖或牵着导盲犬走路，她就永远不必去面对自己的身体不是她想要的样子这个事实。

lines.en: Think of all of the years in all of the loops where the first look on her face in the morning wasn’t one of disappointment or disgust.
lines.zh: 想想在所有的轮回里、所有的那些年中，她每天早上醒来时脸上的第一个表情，不再是失望或厌恶。

lines.en: And think of all the different iterations of me that have told her not to worry about it.
lines.zh: 再想想，有多少个不同的我叫她别去在意。

lines.en: Think of all of the ones that did.
lines.zh: 再想想，又有多少个我确实让她在意了。

lines.en: Think about me. Think about me.
lines.zh: 想想我。想想我。

lines.en: Think about me.
lines.zh: 想想我。

lines.en: Think about me because it’s easier to resent someone {i}worthy{/i} of resentment than someone who doesn’t believe to be even worthy of themselves.
lines.zh: 想想我吧，因为怨恨一个{i}值得{/i}被怨恨的人，总比怨恨一个连自己都不配拥有自己的人要容易。

lines.en: Someone who has harmed absolutely no one, yet feels the weight of the world on her shoulders with each passing moment as if she didn’t already believe she had enough “weight” in the first place.
lines.zh: 一个从未伤害过任何人的人，却每时每刻都觉得整个世界压在自己肩上——仿佛她本来就不觉得自己身上已经有足够的「重量」似的。

lines.en: Think of the me’s that told her she wasn’t good enough. Or the her’s that never tried turning things around. Think of how much it must have hurt.
lines.zh: 想想那些对她说「你还不够好」的我。或者那些从未尝试扭转局面的她。想想那该有多痛。

lines.en: Think of how everything hurts.
lines.zh: 想想一切有多痛。

lines.en: And that even in this slightly more perfect rendition of a world we’ve been stuck in for {s}God{/s} god knows how long, there is still more pain than we can shovel into our pockets.
lines.zh: 想想即便在这个我们被困了天知道多久的、稍稍更完美一点的世界版本里，痛依然多到我们塞不进自己的口袋。

lines.en: It tears through the fabric, like an improperly stored pocket knife- slicing our legs open and causing blood to slowly trickle down the insides of our pants.
lines.zh: 它会撕开布料，就像一把没放好的折刀——划开我们的大腿，让血顺着裤管内侧慢慢淌下来。

lines.en: This train of thought makes me think about Noriko.
lines.zh: 这条思路让我想起了 Noriko。

lines.en: Which leads me into a second train of thought about how I can’t even focus on what’s beside me without my mind wandering off and getting lost.
lines.zh: 接着又引出第二条思路：我连专注于身边的事物都做不到，脑子总是走神、迷路。

lines.en: Without running away.
lines.zh: 没有逃开。

lines.en: I run back.
lines.zh: 我跑了回去。

lines.en: : So...now what?
lines.zh: : 那么……接下来怎么办？

lines.en: : What do you mean?
lines.zh: : 你什么意思？

lines.en: : I mean what do we do now that we’re not at[school]?
lines.zh: : 我的意思是，既然我们不在[school]，现在要做什么？

lines.en: : Did you want to get breakfast or something?
lines.zh: : 你想去吃早餐什么的吗？

lines.en: : I...had a protein bar this morning.
lines.zh: : 我……早上吃了根蛋白棒。

lines.en: : Oh. Well I guess I’ll just starve then.
lines.zh: : 哦。那我看我还是饿死算了。

lines.en: scene futabayumisnow2
: We can still stop somewhere if you’d like. It’s...not like I have anything else to do now that I’m not in the library.
lines.zh: : 你想的话我们还是可以找个地方停下。反正……我不在图书馆了，也没别的事可做。

lines.en: : It’s fine. I’m not really that hungry. I just didn’t really know what else to do.
lines.zh: : 没事。我其实没那么饿。我只是不知道还能干什么。

lines.en: : We can go back to your dorm, I guess.
lines.zh: : 那我们回你宿舍吧。

lines.en: : If it’s okay...I think I’d like to stay out here for a little while longer.
lines.zh: : 如果可以的话……我想在外面再多待一会儿。

lines.en: : Interested in joining the soccer team? We could go see what Miku is up to.
lines.zh: : 有兴趣加入足球队吗？我们可以去看看 Miku 在干什么。

lines.en: scene futabayumisnow3
: I think...just the gym is enough for now.
lines.zh: : 我觉得……光是健身房就已经够了。

lines.en: : I should probably wait a little longer before trying to catch up to someone like Miku.
lines.zh: : 想要追上 Miku 那样的人，我大概还得再等等。

lines.en: : I’m not really much of a fan of sports in the first place.
lines.zh: : 而且我本来也不太喜欢运动。

lines.en: : That’s fine. I’m not either, to be completely honest.
lines.zh: : 没关系。说实话，我也不喜欢。

lines.en: scene futabayumisnow4
: Aren’t you the coach of the soccer team, though?
lines.zh: : 可你不是足球队的教练吗？

lines.en: : Yes. But that position sort of came to me on its own and wasn’t something I went out of my way to acquire.
lines.zh: : 是啊。但那个位置是自己落到我头上的，不是我特意去争取来的。

lines.en: : That seems like a pretty serious thing to just...come to you out of nowhere.
lines.zh: : 这种听起来挺要紧的事，居然就这么……凭空落到你头上。

lines.en: : Well...wherever there are thighs...there will be me.
lines.zh: : 嗯……哪里有大腿……哪里就有我。

lines.en: : It was probably just the universe doing me a favor.
lines.zh: : 大概只是宇宙在帮我一个忙。

lines.en: scene futabayumisnow5
: I’m going to...do everyone a favor and just pretend I never heard that.
lines.zh: : 我打算……帮大家一个忙，假装我从没听见。

lines.en: : No. You {i}did{/i} hear it. I need you to etch this into your memory so you can expand your glossary of sex acts.
lines.zh: : 不。你{i}确实{/i}听见了。我要你把这句刻进记忆里，好扩充你的性行为词汇表。

lines.en: : I mean...there aren’t really any “sex acts” you can use your thighs for.
lines.zh: : 可是……大腿也没什么能用的「性行为」吧。

lines.en: : Oh, Futaba. You still have so much to learn.
lines.zh: : 哦，Futaba。你要学的还多着呢。

lines.en: scene futabayumisnow6
: Wait...is there actually...something like that?
lines.zh: : 等等……真的有……那种事吗？

lines.en: : There is.
: But...how does...
lines.zh: : 可是……怎么……

lines.en: : Remember what we did in the nurse’s office? It’s just like that but...with your thighs.
lines.zh: : 还记得我们在医务室做的那次吗？就跟那个一样，只不过……用你的大腿。

lines.en: : And that feels good?
lines.zh: : 那样舒服吗？

lines.en: : I mean, I doubt it would feel good for you.
lines.zh: : 我是说，我怀疑你不会觉得舒服。

lines.en: : That just sounds difficult.
lines.zh: : 听着就很费劲。

lines.en: : It sounds like good exercise to me.
lines.zh: : 我倒觉得听起来是种很好的锻炼。

lines.en: scene futabayumisnow7
: Oh. So that’s where we’re going with this.
lines.zh: : 哦。原来是往这个方向走啊。

lines.en: : I’m helping you become a better person.
lines.zh: : 我在帮你变成一个更好的人。

lines.en: : No. You’re just turned on.
lines.zh: : 不。你只是硬了。

lines.en: : That’s a side effect. This is really just to make you happier when you wake up in the morning.
lines.zh: : 那是副作用。这真的是为了让你早上醒来时更开心。

lines.en: : There are a lot of easier ways to make me happier in the morning, Sensei.
lines.zh: : Sensei，让我早上更开心的简单方法有很多。

lines.en: : And how many of them involve my penis?
lines.zh: : 其中有多少种用到了我的阴茎？

lines.en: scene futabayumisnow8
: Maybe like...three?
lines.zh: : 大概……三种？

lines.en: : Can you name them?
lines.zh: : 你能说出名字吗？

lines.en: : Not really.
lines.zh: : 说不太出来。

lines.en: : Well then I guess you’ll just have to live your life in misery as I have no idea what else I can do for you.
lines.zh: : 那我看你只能在痛苦中度过余生了，因为我不知道还能为你做什么。

lines.en: : How many times do I have to tell you that you don’t have to do anything for me? Just let me handle this part of my life on my own.
lines.zh: : 我要说多少遍你才明白，你不必为我做什么？这部分人生让我自己来处理就好。

lines.en: : This makes it sound like you have a portable version of my penis.
lines.zh: : 这话听起来，像你随身带了个我的阴茎的便携版。

lines.en: scene futabayumisnow9
: Not everything is about your penis, Sensei!
lines.zh: : 不是什么事都跟你的阴茎有关，Sensei！

lines.en: : You take that back right this instant, [young]lady.
lines.zh: : 你立刻把那句话收回去，[young]小姐。

lines.en: : Are you my dad now?!
lines.zh: : 你现在是我爸吗？！

lines.en: : Do you normally talk about penises with your dad?
lines.zh: : 你平时会跟你爸聊阴茎吗？

lines.en: scene futabayumisnow10
: Hah...I should have stayed in the library...
lines.zh: : 哈……我还不如待在图书馆……

lines.en: : Come to think of it, I’m pretty sure I overheard you saying something about your parents coming to visit when you were on the phone earlier.
lines.zh: : 话说回来，我好像确实听到你刚才在电话里提到你父母要来看你的事。

lines.en: scene futabayumisnow4
: Were you really listening for that long?
lines.zh: : 你真的听了那么久？

lines.en: : I was. And, sorry for asking but, is something like that even possible?
lines.zh: : 是的。还有，抱歉要问这个，但那种事真的有可能吗？

lines.en: scene futabayumisnow11
: I don’t really know...But it seems like that’s exactly the issue.
lines.zh: : 我也不知道……但看起来问题恰恰就在这里。

lines.en: : They were under the impression that they’d be able to get a pass that would allow them to return since they were away on work, but it seems the process isn’t as easy as it sounds.
lines.zh: : 他们本来以为，既然是因公外出，就能拿到允许他们回来的通行证，可这手续似乎没听起来那么简单。

lines.en: : This city gets more and more confusing with each passing day.
lines.zh: : 这座城市一天比一天让人摸不着头脑。

lines.en: : You think so? It seems mostly normal to me.
lines.zh: : 你这么觉得吗？我觉得基本挺正常的。

lines.en: : But...I’ve also never really lived anywhere else for more than a month or two, so I’m probably not the best judge of that.
lines.zh: : 不过……我也从来没有在别的地方住超过一两个月，所以我大概不是最有发言权的人。

lines.en: : I just don’t get what the big deal is.
lines.zh: : 我只是不明白这有什么大不了的。

lines.en: : Like, why block off the city if-
lines.zh: : 就好比，为什么要封锁城市，如果——

lines.en: scene futabayumisnow12
: Wait...hold on a second.
lines.zh: : 等等……等一下。

lines.en: : What’s wrong?
lines.zh: : 怎么了？

lines.en: : There’s...someone leaning up against the wall.
lines.zh: : 有……有个人靠在墙上。

lines.en: : Were we talking about something they shouldn’t be listening to?
lines.zh: : 我们刚才是不是说了什么不该被她听到的话？

lines.en: : No...it’s just...
: Look.
lines.zh: : 你看。

lines.en: scene black
scene futabayumisnow13
Futaba and I find Yumi with her back pressed against some sort of anime billboard and I think for a second about how she would look in cosplay.
lines.zh: Futaba 和我发现 Yumi 背靠着一块动画广告牌，我还花了一秒钟想了想她出 COS 会是什么样子。

lines.en: Of course, I realize seconds later that I should probably be thinking about more important things.
lines.zh: 当然，几秒后我意识到，我大概该想想更重要的事。

lines.en: Like how to explain why I’m out walking around with Futaba at this time of the morning.
lines.zh: 比如该怎么解释，为什么我会在清晨这个时候和 Futaba 在外面散步。

lines.en: Then again, I’ve also spent time in the city with Yumi and there’s nothing going on between {i}us{/i} so...
lines.zh: 话说回来，我也和 Yumi 一起在城里逛过，而{i}我们{/i}之间什么都没有，所以……

lines.en: Well, except for that one thing.
lines.zh: 好吧，除了那一件事。

lines.en: But yeah, you get what I mean.
lines.zh: 不过，你懂我的意思。

lines.en: : Umm...G...Good morning, Yumi...
lines.zh: : 呃……早……早上好，Yumi……

lines.en: : Don’t have to stop and fuckin’ greet me, you know. Not really in the mood to talk.
lines.zh: : 不用停下来跟我他妈问好，你知道的。我今天没心情说话。

lines.en: : Are you ever in the mood to talk?
lines.zh: : 你什么时候有心情说话过？

lines.en: : Nope. Now get the fuck away from me. Too early for this shit.
lines.zh: : 没有。现在给我滚远点。大清早的搞这种事。

lines.en: : Umm...Sensei and I...
lines.zh: : 呃……Sensei 和我……

lines.en: : Don’t fucking care. You ain’t holdin’ hands or anything so I ain’t got a reason to get all pissed.
lines.zh: : 我才他妈不在乎。你们又没牵手什么的，我也没理由发火。

lines.en: : Just take the fucking hint and keep walking. I’m not starting anything today.
lines.zh: : 识相点继续走你们的。我今天不想挑事。

lines.en: : Are you okay?
lines.zh: : 你还好吗？

lines.en: scene futabayumisnow14
: The fuck do you care? I am making this as easy as fuckin’ possible for you! Just leave me alone!
lines.zh: : 你他妈关心个什么劲？我已经把这事给你简化到不能再简单了！别管我！

lines.en: : I just-
lines.zh: : 我只是——

lines.en: : Again, don’t care!
lines.zh: : 再说一遍，我不在乎！

lines.en: : I’m doin’ that whole “Ain’t got nothin’ nice to say, so don’t say anything” bit and you’re tryin’ to fuck me up!
lines.zh: : 我正在实践那套「没好话就别说」的原则，你却在坏我的事！

lines.en: : Just go hang out or whatever! I’m stayin’ out of your way!
lines.zh: : 去约会什么的吧！我没挡你们的道！

lines.en: : I’m shocked.
lines.zh: : 我震惊了。

lines.en: : Why?!
lines.zh: : 为什么？！

lines.en: : This just...might be the nicest thing I’ve ever seen you do.
lines.zh: : 这……大概是我见过你做过最善良的事了。

lines.en: scene futabayumisnow15
: Suck my dick, you [niece]-fucking shitbag.
lines.zh: : 去舔我的鸡巴吧，你这个操[niece]的混蛋。

lines.en: : That’s-
lines.zh: : 那个——

lines.en: : It’s fine. Baby steps, Futaba. Baby steps.
lines.zh: : 没事。慢慢来，Futaba。慢慢来。

lines.en: : She’ll get there.
lines.zh: : 她会好起来的。

lines.en: : R-Right...
The three of us stand there for a moment, causing the air to get noticeably less comfortable.
lines.zh: 我们三个就这么站了一会儿，空气明显变得尴尬起来。

lines.en: I start walking away to end the situation and get on with the day, but Futaba keeps her feet planted.
lines.zh: 我开始走开，好结束这个场面、继续过这一天，可 Futaba 的双脚像生了根。

lines.en: I’m not sure what it is she wants to accomplish by doing so, but-
lines.zh: 我不确定她这么做是想达成什么，不过——

lines.en: : Yumi...
lines.zh: : Yumi……

lines.en: : Did...did you want to...hang out with us, maybe?
lines.zh: : 你……你要不要……和我们一起逛逛？

lines.en: Oh, okay. So that’s what’s going on here.
lines.zh: 哦，好吧。原来是这么回事。

lines.en: I stop myself from leaving and turn to see how the rest of this...exchange goes.
lines.zh: 我停下脚步，转过身看这场……交流要怎么收场。

lines.en: scene futabayumisnow16
: No. Get the fuck away from me.
lines.zh: : 不。给我滚远点。

lines.en: : Okay, but...I think it...might be nice actually getting to spend time with you for once...
lines.zh: : 好的，可是……我觉得……能和你好好相处一次，其实挺好的……

lines.en: : Why? All I do is make fun of you and shit. You some kind of masochist?
lines.zh: : 为什么？我除了嘲笑你之类的什么都没干过。你是受虐狂吗？

lines.en: : No, but...I just...have a hard time accepting that’s the real you.
lines.zh: : 不是，只是……我很难相信那才是真正的你。

lines.en: : No idea what the fuck you’re talkin’ about, but the “real me” wants to be left alone. Now beat it before I punch your fucking teeth in.
lines.zh: : 不知道你他妈在说什么，不过「真正的我」现在只想一个人待着。趁我还没把你的牙打飞，赶紧滚。

lines.en: scene futabayumisnow17
: Hehehe...
lines.zh: : 嘿嘿嘿……

lines.en: : ...The fuck you laughing at?
lines.zh: : ……你他妈笑什么？

lines.en: : If this is some kind of...weird fucking test or something-
lines.zh: : 如果这是什么……奇怪的测试之类的——

lines.en: : No no no...it’s nothing like that.
lines.zh: : 不不不……不是那样的。

lines.en: : I was just thinking that...
lines.zh: : 我只是在想……

lines.en: : You look a lot like your mom when you start...being intimidating like that...
lines.zh: : 你发起狠来那个样子……很像你妈妈……

lines.en: scene futabayumisnow18
Uh-oh.
lines.zh: 哦豁。

lines.en: Bad move, Futaba.
lines.zh: 这步棋走错了，Futaba。

lines.en: : The fuck did you just say to me?
lines.zh: : 你他妈刚才跟我说什么？

lines.en: : I...wait...
: What did I do?
lines.zh: : 我做了什么？

lines.en: : What the fuck did you just say to me? Say it again.
lines.zh: : 你他妈刚才说什么了？再说一遍。

lines.en: : I want to hear it.
lines.zh: : 我想听听。

lines.en: scene futabayumisnow19
: I...I just thought...
lines.zh: : 我……我只是觉得……

lines.en: : Futaba, come on. Yumi’s not in the mood to talk right now.
lines.zh: : Futaba，行了。Yumi 现在没心情说话。

lines.en: : Oh no. I’m in the mood to talk now. I’d {i}love{/i} to talk, actually.
lines.zh: : 哦不。我现在有心情说话了。我还真{i}挺想{/i}聊的。

lines.en: : So go on. Tell me again.
lines.zh: : 来吧。再说一遍。

lines.en: : Who did I look like just now?
lines.zh: : 我刚才像谁？

lines.en: : You...
: You looked kind of like...your mom...
lines.zh: : 你看起来有点像……你妈妈……

lines.en: scene futabayumisnow20
Yumi grabs Futaba by the shoulders and spins her around, throwing her up against the billboard that she’d been leaning on herself just seconds ago.
lines.zh: Yumi 抓住 Futaba 的肩膀，把她转过来一把推到广告牌上——而几秒钟前，靠在那儿的人还是她自己。

lines.en: She rears back her fist and punches the wall, which allows me to breathe a sigh of relief on the way over as I thought she was about to kill a classmate.
lines.zh: 她抡起拳头砸在墙上，这让我在走过去时松了一口气，因为我原以为她要打死一个同学。

lines.en: : Listen here you fat, fucking bitch. I am {i}nothing{/i} like my mother. Nothing.
lines.zh: : 给我听好了，你这个死胖子婊子。我和我妈{i}一点都不像{/i}。一点也不像。

lines.en: : Got it?
lines.zh: : 听明白了吗？

lines.en: : I...Yumi-
lines.zh: : 我……Yumi——

lines.en: scene futabayumisnow21
: Got it?!
lines.zh: : 听明白了吗？！

lines.en: : Yes! I’m sorry!
lines.zh: : 明白了！对不起！

lines.en: : You been pokin’ around for dirt on me or some shit?! So tired of me picking on you that you have to get involved in my fucking personal life?!
lines.zh: : 你是在四处挖我的黑料还是什么的？！被我欺负烦了，就要来插手我的私生活？！

lines.en: : No! I just...met her and...
lines.zh: : 不是！我只是……见过她，然后……

lines.en: : I don’t care what your fucking excuse is! You stay out of my shit and I’ll stay out of yours!
lines.zh: : 我才不管你他妈有什么借口！你别管我的事，我也不管你的！

lines.en: : I told you to just fucking walk away, didn’t I?! I was gonna leave you alone!
lines.zh: : 我他妈叫你直接走开，不是吗？！我本来打算不搭理你的！

lines.en: : But you must have seen that and decided, “Oh! Yumi looks vulnerable today! Time to hit her where it hurts!”
lines.zh: : 可你大概是看见了，就想着：「哦！Yumi 今天看起来很脆弱！是时候往她痛处戳了！」

lines.en: : Is that right?! Is that what you're doing?!
lines.zh: : 是吧？！你就是在干这个吧？！

lines.en: : Fuck you! Fuck you fuck you fuck you!
lines.zh: : 操你的！操你的操你的操你的！

lines.en: : I...really didn’t mean to...
lines.zh: : 我……真的不是故意的……

lines.en: scene futabayumisnow22
: Come on. That’s enough.
lines.zh: : 行了。够了。

lines.en: : No! It’s not fucking enough! Do you have any idea who that “mother” of mine actually is?!
lines.zh: : 不！这他妈还不够！你知道我那个「妈妈」到底是什么货色吗？！

lines.en: : I...didn’t even know it was your mom until a little while ago...
lines.zh: : 我……直到不久前才知道她是你妈妈……

lines.en: : Of course you didn’t! Just a tiny, little mistake from a big, fucking girl!
lines.zh: : 你当然不知道！一个又大又壮的女孩犯了个小小的错误嘛！

lines.en: : Doesn’t even matter, right?!
lines.zh: : 根本无所谓，对吧？！

lines.en: : Right?!
lines.zh: : 对吧？！

lines.en: : Yumi, let go. Futaba and I were leaving.
lines.zh: : Yumi，放手。Futaba 和我要走了。

lines.en: scene futabayumisnow23
: Yeah. Of {i}fucking{/i} course you were.
lines.zh: : 是啊。你们{i}他妈{/i}当然要走了。

lines.en: : You gonna go have a good time with the teacher, Futaba?
lines.zh: : 你打算和老师去过好日子了，Futaba？

lines.en: : Gonna go feel better about yourself while he sits there and tells you your size doesn’t matter or some shit?
lines.zh: : 打算让他坐在那儿跟你说你的身材根本无所谓之类的，好让你自我感觉良好？

lines.en: : Gonna stuff your fucking face with junk food while looking down on people like me? People who never even got to know their parents?!
lines.zh: : 打算一边往嘴里塞垃圾食品，一边瞧不起像我这样的人？像我这种根本没机会了解自己父母的人？！

lines.en: scene futabayumisnow24
: No! Don’t close your fucking eyes, cunt!
lines.zh: : 不！别他妈闭上眼睛，贱人！

lines.en: : Look at me and tell me again how acting intimidating makes me look like a fucking junkie who can’t even be bothered to take care of a little girl!
lines.zh: : 看着我，再说一遍啊——说我摆出那副凶样子，就让我看起来像个连小女孩都懒得照顾的瘾君子！

lines.en: : I should fucking kill you right here!
lines.zh: : 我真该现在就在这儿宰了你！

lines.en: : Yumi-
lines.zh: : Yumi——

lines.en: : Never talk about my mother again! Got it?!
lines.zh: : 再敢提我妈一句！听明白了吗？！

lines.en: : Yes! Yes! I won’t!
lines.zh: : 明白了！明白了！我不会了！

lines.en: scene black
scene futabayumisnow25
: Do you have something to do with this?
lines.zh: : 这事跟你有关吗？

lines.en: : Yes.
: It’s my fault. Futaba doesn’t know anything about your relationship with your mother.
lines.zh: : 是我的错。Futaba 对你和你母亲的事一无所知。

lines.en: : Well she certainly knows something now.
lines.zh: : 那她现在肯定知道点什么了。

lines.en: : It’s all one big misunderstanding.
lines.zh: : 这全是一场大误会。

lines.en: : Was it a misunderstanding when you told me you wouldn’t get involved anymore?
lines.zh: : 那你跟我说过不会再插手的时候，也是误会吗？

lines.en: : Am I too fucking dumb to understand what that means, Sensei?
lines.zh: : Sensei，我是不是他妈蠢到听不懂那句话是什么意思？

lines.en: : Yumi-
lines.zh: : Yumi——

lines.en: : I don’t know what the {i}fuck{/i} you are trying to do to me, but {i}stop{/i} getting involved with my family.
lines.zh: : 我不知道你{i}他妈{/i}到底想对我做什么，但{i}别再{/i}插手我家的事。

lines.en: : Leave me alone.
lines.zh: : 别管我。

lines.en: : And if you’re going to drag other people into it, at least drag in someone who will actually put up a fucking fight so I don’t feel like I’m about to strangle a defenseless little kid.
lines.zh: : 还有，如果你非要拉别人进来，至少拉个真能还手的人，别让我觉得自己快要掐死一个毫无还手之力的小孩。

lines.en: : I’m sorry. It was an accident.
lines.zh: : 对不起。那是个意外。

lines.en: : Yeah, and so was I. But I’m fucking here now. And I don’t need my teacher and his walking fucking morale booster to show up out of thin air and remind me of that.
lines.zh: : 是啊，我也是个意外。可我现在他妈就在这儿。我不需要我的老师和他那个会走路的士气增强器从天而降，来提醒我这件事。

lines.en: : Yumi...
lines.zh: : Yumi……

lines.en: : Just...leave me the fuck alone.
lines.zh: : 就……别他妈管我。

lines.en: scene black
scene futabayumisnow26
: Are you okay?
lines.zh: : 你还好吗？

lines.en: : Yeah...but...
: That was just a really bad coincidence.
lines.zh: : 那真是个糟糕透顶的巧合。

lines.en: : I didn’t expect to run into Yumi without warning you to never bring up that...{i}subject{/i} around her.
lines.zh: : 我没料到会碰见 Yumi，也没提前警告过你，绝不能在她面前提起那个{i}话题{/i}。

lines.en: : That...was a pretty important detail to leave out...
lines.zh: : 那……可是个相当重要的细节，你居然漏掉了……

lines.en: : If you weren’t here, I...
lines.zh: : 如果你不在，我……

lines.en: : If I wasn’t here, you never would have learned about Yumi’s mother in the first place.
lines.zh: : 如果我不在，你根本就不会知道 Yumi 母亲的事。

lines.en: : So let’s just call it a day and go back to the dorm.
lines.zh: : 所以今天就到这儿吧，回宿舍去。

lines.en: : I’m sure Yumi wants to forget this even more than the two of us do, so just don’t bring it up again and everything should be okay.
lines.zh: : 我敢说 Yumi 比我们俩更想把这事忘掉，所以别再提了，一切都会好起来的。

lines.en: : You...
scene futabayumisnow27
: You two must be...getting pretty close if you know things about Yumi’s family...
lines.zh: : 你们两个……一定关系相当密切吧，连 Yumi 家里的事都知道……

lines.en: : I thought Chika was the only one who...knew anything about that...
lines.zh: : 我还以为 Chika 是唯一一个……知道那些事的人……

lines.en: : “Close” definitely isn’t the right word, but I don’t think now is the best time to really deep-dive into such a convoluted relationship.
lines.zh: : 「密切」肯定不是合适的词，不过现在实在不是深挖这么一段错综复杂的关系的好时机。

lines.en: : Yeah...probably not...
lines.zh: : 嗯……大概不是……

lines.en: : I’m sorry if I managed to...make it even more convoluted, though.
lines.zh: : 不过，如果我把这事弄得更错综复杂了，我很抱歉。

lines.en: : She’s said a lot of mean things to me before, but...I’ve never really seen her get like that.
lines.zh: : 她以前对我说过很多难听的话，可是……我从来没见过她那个样子。

lines.en: : And, if everything plays out the way it should, you never will again.
lines.zh: : 而如果一切按应有的样子发展，你也不会再见到。

lines.en: : Let’s go back for now, though. I’m sorry I didn’t warn you ahead of time.
lines.zh: : 不过先回去吧。抱歉我没提前提醒你。

lines.en: scene futabayumisnow28
: It’s okay...
lines.zh: : 没关系……

lines.en: : This is just what I get for...trying to be nice to someone who doesn’t want anything to do with me.
lines.zh: : 这就是我……非要去对一个根本不想理我的人好的下场。

lines.en: scene black
Futaba and I head back to the dorm in almost complete silence.
lines.zh: Futaba 和我几乎是一路沉默地回宿舍。

lines.en: We try making conversation about a few random things along the way, but nothing really sticks.
lines.zh: 我们试图在路上聊几句有的没的，可什么都没聊开。

lines.en: The air is too uncomfortable and awkward after what we just experienced.
lines.zh: 刚刚经历的那件事之后，空气太难受、太尴尬了。

lines.en: It’s strange how quickly things can fall apart just by being in the wrong place at the wrong time.
lines.zh: 仅仅因为在错误的时间出现在错误的地点，一切就能崩得这么快，真是奇怪。

lines.en: But it’s even crazier that, for some people, every place and every time is always wrong.
lines.zh: 更疯狂的是，对某些人来说，每个地点、每个时间永远都是错的。

lines.en: And there’s nothing we can really do about it.
lines.zh: 而我们对此真的无能为力。

lines.en: We’ll just keep existing and keep hoping that tomorrow will be more convenient than today.
lines.zh: 我们只会继续存在下去，继续盼着明天比今天更好过一点。

lines.en: Sometimes it will be.
lines.zh: 有时候确实会。

lines.en: Other times, it would probably be better to not exist at all.
lines.zh: 其他时候，也许根本不存在会更好。
